_comment: Phrase patterns for extracting a numeric bound (min/max/exact/range)
from a criterion's own wording, e.g. 'at least 15 references' or
'must not exceed 100 pages'. Data, not code (charter rule 7) — a
rubric phrased differently is accommodated by editing this file.
Tried in this order: range, min, max, exact, bare (a lone number next
to a recognized unit word, with no comparison phrase at all).
max: (?:at most|maximum(?: of)?|no more than|not (?:exceed|more than)|must not exceed|<=|≤|up to)\s*(?P<num1>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?P<unit>[a-zA-Z]*)
